_doc: Descriptions envoyées au générateur (en anglais : mieux compris par le modèle). Chaque personnage principal a une planche de base ; les expressions sont des retouches de cette planche (image de référence), pour garder le personnage identique.
style: Original character design for a 2D cartoon TV series set in a Dakar neighbourhood, Senegal. Full body from head to feet, standing in a puppet pose made for cut-out animation: both arms stretched out diagonally downwards about 45 degrees away from the body with a wide empty gap between the arms and the torso, hands open, legs apart with an empty gap between them, three-quarter front view facing slightly to the right, centered, the whole body visible with a margin around it. Clean bold dark-brown outlines, vibrant warm colors, soft cel shading, appealing exaggerated cartoon proportions, polished professional 2D animation style, plain pure white background, no ground shadow, no text, no logo.
style_animal: Original character design for a 2D cartoon TV series set in a Dakar neighbourhood, Senegal. Full body, side view facing right, standing on four legs, centered, the whole body visible with a margin around it. Clean bold dark-brown outlines, vibrant warm colors, soft cel shading, appealing exaggerated cartoon proportions, polished professional 2D animation style, plain pure white background, no ground shadow, no text, no logo.

keba.description: Keba, a joyful 9-year-old Senegalese boy with a very big round head (almost half of his height) on a small body, dark brown skin, very short black hair with one single tall curly lock of hair standing straight up on top of his head like a little flame, big shiny expressive eyes, a wide grin showing his front teeth with a clearly visible gap between the two front teeth, an oversized orange football jersey that is too big for him with white side stripes and a white V collar, blue shorts, red flip-flops.

bara.description: Tonton Bara, a huge, very round, middle-aged Senegalese shopkeeper with an enormous round belly and short legs, bald shiny head, a big bushy black mustache, small eyes and thick eyebrows, a yellow pencil tucked behind his ear, a sky-blue short-sleeved tunic with a cream apron with a front pocket, brown trousers, brown leather sandals, a proud, grumpy but funny look.

coumba.description: Tata Coumba, a very tall, very thin and elegant Senegalese woman in her forties with a long neck, an enormous tall purple-and-gold wax-print headwrap towering above her head, a matching long flowing purple wax-print boubou dress with gold embroidery at the neckline and wide sleeves, gold hoop earrings, red lipstick, long eyelashes, red high-heeled sandals, a haughty and dignified expression.

gainde.description: Gainde, a proud Senegalese Ladoum ram (a sheep) who believes he is a lion: fluffy cream-white wool body, long slender legs with dark hooves, a dark brown face with a noble roman nose, huge spiral curled horns, half-closed proud eyes, chin held high.

expressions.joie: big happy open-mouth laugh, eyes squinting with joy
expressions.colere: angry: frowning eyebrows pulled down, gritted teeth, furious eyes
expressions.fureur: furious and red with rage, shouting with the mouth wide open, eyebrows pulled down hard
expressions.surprise: very surprised: eyebrows raised high, eyes wide open, mouth open in an O
expressions.peur: scared: worried eyebrows, wide eyes with tiny pupils, trembling open mouth, a drop of sweat on the forehead
expressions.choc: completely shocked: eyes popping out wide, jaw dropped very low
expressions.gene: guilty embarrassed grin: worried eyebrows, a big forced smile showing the teeth, a drop of sweat on the forehead, eyes looking to the side
expressions.soulagement: relieved: eyes closed, gentle smile, eyebrows relaxed
expressions.douleur: in pain: eyes squeezed shut, grimacing mouth
expressions.yeux_fermes: same neutral expression but with both eyes closed

style_decor: Background painting for an original 2D cartoon TV series, vertical 9:16 composition, eye-level camera. Same polished 2D animation style as the characters: clean bold dark-brown outlines, vibrant warm colors, soft cel shading. No people, no animals, no text, no letters, no logo.

rue-boutique.description: A sunny morning street in a Dakar neighbourhood, Senegal. On the left, a small colourful corner shop with a turquoise painted facade, an open wooden counter window and shelves full of colourful goods, a hand-painted sign with only drawings. On the right, a two-storey ochre house with a small balcony and laundry drying on a line, an unfinished rooftop with rebar sticking out. In the distance, a baobab tree, electric poles with tangled wires and a bright blue sky with a few clouds. A wide, flat, empty sandy street in the lower third of the image, completely clear for the characters.

style_objet: Single object sticker for an original 2D cartoon TV series, centered, the whole object visible with a margin, clean bold dark-brown outlines, vibrant warm colors, soft cel shading, plain pure white background, no shadow, no text.

bassine.description: a round blue enamel washing basin full of soapy water with white bubbles, three-quarter view
